# Efficacy — Metrics and the Feedback Loop

Two kinds of metric plus the loop back to diff. Delivery metrics (editing %, %CAR+, expression) and action metrics (RECIST, MRD/ctDNA) are countable — computable. But the link metric → clinical outcome (surrogacy) is empirical and unsettled (ctDNA not an accepted OS/DFS surrogate; in-vivo editing measurement "aspirational"). Resistance/evolution closes the cycle: antigen-negative subclones drive relapse and feed a new diff (see [map.md](../map.md)).
